description:
[read-only] The brand's connected Mercatus Liber store (URL, name, scopes and import state), or `store: null`. Never includes the store key. `brandId` is required on an account-wide connection. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/stores/mercatus/connect.)

brandId.description: The brand (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

name: mercatus_store_status
title: Get the brand's Mercatus store
